# ============================================================================
# PROBED 2026-07-28. 968 of these 999 slugs are now registered sources.
#
# These 999 Personio career-site subdomains were recovered by a research pass in
# a container with no outbound access to job boards. Every one has since been
# probed live at https://<slug>.jobs.personio.de/xml?language=en, falling back
# to the .com host when the .de one did not answer with a feed.
#
# Result, measured and not estimated:
#
#   ok    968   <workzag-jobs> with >=1 <position>          11,920 postings
#   empty  25   <workzag-jobs> with no positions
#   dead    6   HTTP 307 to https://personio.com
#
# The 968 "ok" slugs are registered in internal/services/personio.go, together
# with the two previously-registered slugs that answered empty ("circula",
# "deepset") — docs/adding-a-source.md is explicit that a company not hiring
# today is not a broken source. The other 23 empty slugs are NOT registered.
#
#   dead:   rocycle jotelulu clikalia cobee globus-ai welevel
#
# A dead Personio tenant does NOT 404. It answers HTTP 307 to
# https://personio.com — on .de and .com alike — so a client that follows
# redirects spends the request on the vendor's marketing site instead. Probing
# just those six was enough to make personio.com start returning 429.
# personioFeedDocument now refuses to follow a redirect off the tenant's host.
#
# The comment below that "a .com-only tenant would need its own list" is only
# half right: personioHost() already accepts a full host, so a .com tenant is
# registered as one. Measured, there are exactly two in 999 — lnds and weclapp
# — appended at the end of this file as full hosts.
#
# Promotion rule, gated on content and not on status code: keep a slug whose
# https://<slug>.jobs.personio.de/xml answers 200 with a document whose root
# element is <workzag-jobs> and whose <position> count is above zero. Publishing
# the feed is a per-tenant switch on this platform, so a tenant that has not
# enabled it is a live company with no feed, not a dead slug.
#
# The employer names and counts on the rows below are the upstream curator's,
# dated as annotated. They are recorded as provenance, not endorsed, and the
# rows are left verbatim — the live results are recorded in this header rather
# than by editing them.
# ============================================================================
#
# Personio career-site subdomains to poll (one per line, # = comment).
# The subdomain is the label in a company's Personio career URL, e.g.
#   https://holidu.jobs.personio.de  -> holidu
# Used verbatim as the {label}.jobs.personio.de host AND part of the posting id
# (apply-URL recovery). We assume the .de domain (the common default); a
# .com-only tenant would need its own list.
# Polled by download/fetch_personio.py via the public /xml?language=en feed
# (no auth); the feed carries the full HTML description (no detail fetch needed).
#
# Harvested via site-scoped web search + probing, then VERIFIED live against
# /xml (kept only position count>0, 2026-06-09). Heavily DACH/EU SMB.
